searchText: kind of random question, but have people considered that when sepolia is "retired" it is probably valuable to have another chain with some "PoW" component so it is as similar to Mainnet as possible? We can, but its gonna be very very annoying to set it up and we should be sure we need it + test it ahead of time + clients still have the merge/pow mining codebases working
